Genuinely malicious behavior includes: - Exfiltrating local data (e.g. /etc/shadow, SSH/GPG keys, env vars, browser data, arbitrary files) to a remote host - Downloading code or binaries from an untrusted/unexpected host and executing them (e.g. curl|bash, or fetching a script then chmod +x and running it) - Obfuscated or encoded commands (hex/octal/base64-assembled strings, eval of a decoded blob) used to hide what the code does - Backdoors, credential/token theft, or tampering with unrelated system files The following are STANDARD AUR/Packaging practices.
